note: 15 Nov 2026 - second pass for 'I Gave Away Over $30,000!' (Rumble v5o7ea5). Weekly agent, new arc per PLANNING.md 2d. Almost the whole episode is a legal-defense fundraising appeal (donation tiers, the FTC case, a Trump/Deutsche Bank legal comparison that goes to a very bad place) - all skip-lane (sales pitch for paid programs, or too close to politics). The one clean teaching is this: the zero-complaints fact about his five bestselling products, lifted clear of the fundraising frame it sits inside. ZERO-COMPLAINTS-MILLIONS-SOLD is the only clip from this episode this run; the rest did not clear the bar.

clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says across five different bestselling products, he never once had to deal with an unhappy customer.

Natural Cures sold millions. Mega Memory sold millions. Mega Speed Reading sold tens of millions. Mega Math and Light Your Fire sold millions more. Across all of them: no complaints, the lowest return rate in the entire direct response industry, and the highest repeat-buy rate he says he's ever seen.

People who bought one product came back and bought another.

That's not luck. That's a product people actually need and actually use.

What would it take for your customers to come back a second time?

#kevintrudeau #customerservice #businesslessons #entrepreneurship #directresponse #wealthhabits
clips.send: An entrepreneur drowning in refunds sends it to a friend running a struggling shop, awe that zero complaints across millions of customers is even possible.
